User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Allow all jewelry category pages
Allow: /collection
Allow: /collection?category=rings
Allow: /collection?category=necklaces
Allow: /collection?category=bracelets
Allow: /collection?category=earrings
Allow: /collection?category=watches

# Allow specific jewelry type pages
Allow: /collection?type=diamond-rings
Allow: /collection?type=engagement-rings
Allow: /collection?type=wedding-bands
Allow: /collection?type=gold-necklaces
Allow: /collection?type=silver-jewelry

# Allow main pages
Allow: /about
Allow: /contact
Allow: /product/*

# Disallow admin and private areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /orders
Disallow: /place-order
Disallow: /verify

# Disallow search parameters that don't add SEO value
Disallow: /*?search=*
Disallow: /*?sort=*
Disallow: /*?filter=*

# Sitemap location
Sitemap: https://luxejewelry.com/sitemap.xml

# Crawl delay (optional - helps prevent server overload)
Crawl-delay: 1
